cands.bio: Republican state representative for Alabama House District 31 since November 2022. Financial advisor at First Community Bank of Central Alabama and former co-owner of Frios Gourmet Pops in Wetumpka. Served six years as chairman of the Elmore County Commission before joining the House.
cands.gaps: We could not find where Stubbs grew up or when he moved to Alabama. The pages we read list no bills he sponsored, and we found no specific actions or stated positions on data centers, property taxes, land ownership, growth and land conservation, immigration or H-1B, police funding, abortion, or school choice and teacher pay. His campaign site's issue pages (Conservative Values, Economic Vitality, Education, Healthcare, Public Safety, Infrastructure) were listed but their text was not available. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2022 or 2026, and Ballotpedia lists no endorsements for 2026. We found no controversies and no foreign ties in the pages we had.

local.label: Roots 55: He was born in Charleston, SC, and his campaign site says he met his wife, an eighth-generation Elmore County resident, while earning his finance degree at the University of Alabama, and that they have lived in Wetumpka and been married 25 years; neither page says where he grew up or when he moved to Alabama. · Money: 9% of money from District 31 ZIP codes

qual.background: Alabama House member since 2022, six years as Elmore County Commission chairman, financial advisor at a bank, and former co-owner of a small retail business, with a finance degree and master's degrees in sports administration and secondary mathematics.
qual.why: Prior legislative service and a county elected office with budget responsibility, plus a finance career and small-business ownership, put him in the high range. Committee assignments and board seats were not counted.
